domestic_evidence: Company website rashmimetaliks.com states: "Rashmi Metaliks - World's 2nd largest ductile iron pipe manufacturer with 2,400,000 MT annual capacity. Among the largest DI pipe manufacturers globally, serving 50+ countries with premium quality steel products including DI pipes, TMT bars, and more. India's largest ductile iron pipe producer." This is a self-declaration only. No GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender award, no published contract and no annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply therefore remains declared, not confirmed.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records with HS codes and destinations (UK, Vietnam, UAE, Iraq), including intra-group shipments to Rashmi Metaliks UK Ltd and Rashmi Metaliks Bahrain W.L.L. Declared HS 721499 (flat-rolled stainless/other alloy steel) does not match the observed export HS codes: the dominant observed code is 73030030 (ductile iron pipes/tubes), plus 34039900 (lubricants) and 84272000 (fork-lift trucks). Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: company is retained, actual HS should be corrected to 73030030 as the primary export code. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the free views accessed, not invented. Domestic supply: no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence obtained; only website claims, hence declared_only. No signs of non-existence; legal entity active in customs records as recently as 2026-02-25.
